name: DARK Rewards
install:
set -euo pipefail
roots=()
for r in /workspace /agent "$PWD"; do [ -d "$r" ] && roots+=("$r"); done
SCRIPT=$(find "${roots[@]}" -maxdepth 5 \( -path '*/node_modules' -o -path '*/.git' \) -prune -o -type f -path '*/.cursor/install.sh' -print -quit)
[ -n "$SCRIPT" ]
exec bash "$SCRIPT"
start:
set -euo pipefail

[ -n "$SCRIPT" ]
exec bash "$SCRIPT"
